summary_1line: Maya the Danava offers repayment to Arjuna and builds a wondrous सभा (assembly hall) for Yudhishthira at Krishna’s request.

image_candidates.scene_text: Maya the Danava stands with folded hands before Arjuna and Krishna, offering to build a magnificent palace in gratitude for his life.
The supernatural architect Maya lays out a vast square plot while Brahmanas are fed and rituals sanctify the foundation of Yudhishthira’s future hall.
A dazzling celestial-like assembly hall rises at Khandavaprastha, blending divine, human, and asuric designs in impossible architecture.
